thread:
Maya Patel: ok team — draft webinar script + snackpack for Platform Ops attached. Goal: 35-min webinar (25m presentation + 10m q&a), quick benchmarks, routing play, and a 1-page takeaway. Need messaging edits and inbound routing matrix. Can people skim and flag blockers by EOD? :raised_hands:

Maya Patel: Opening 45s script (feel free to tighten):
```
Hi everyone — I’m Maya from Redwood Inference. Today we'll show how to run LLM inference reliably at scale while keeping latency and costs predictable. We’ll walk through a real customer benchmark, deployment patterns (hosted / dedicated / private), and the exact playbook we use to keep SLAs when traffic spikes. Stick around for product tips and a short Q&A.
```

Maya Patel: Key assets included in thread: 1) 1-page takeaway (security + SLA bullets), 2) 3 benchmark callouts (latency/cost/throughput), 3) slide deck outline (12 slides), 4) inbound routing mapping for leads.

Tom Huang: looks solid. two quick asks: change opener to call out the customer vertical (finserv) in one line — helps creds. also change CTA to "request a runbook" instead of "contact sales" — more ops-friendly. :+1:

Kevin O'Neill: benchmark snips — prefer these three headline metrics: median p99 latency (ms) on dedicated, token cost delta vs hosted, and steady-state throughput (req/s) with batching. Suggest wording: "3x latency improvement with Dedicated + smart KV caching in spiky workloads"

Sarah Gomez: slide count ok. can we get 1 slide that shows canary/rollback flow? ops teams always ask about failover. keep it visual with 3 boxes: canary -> monitor -> rollback/fallback.

Leo Rivera: inbound routing draft for platform-ops leads: quick matrix — if prospect selects "security & compliance" + "private deployment" route to AE-enterprise + solutions engineer, tag with "private-hot". if "latency-sensitive" route to platform-ops SDR first then AE if >$X ARR. quick pseudo-rule:
```
if (deployment == "private" && compliance == true) { assign: "AE-enterprise", tag: "private-hot" }
else if (latency == "p99<150ms") { assign: "SDR-platform-ops", tag: "low-latency" }
else { assign: "Inbound-Field", tag: "standard" }
```

Maya Patel: perfect, Leo. Can you add the routing tags we need in HubSpot (private-hot, low-latency, benchmark-lead)? make those values exact so ops doesn't guess.

Leo Rivera: will add exact tags. also adding email nurture: "private-deploy checklist" doc link in first touch for private-hot.

Tom Huang: messaging tweak for slide 2 (problem statement): replace "hard to serve models" with "hard to serve reliably at scale" — emphasizes reliability. also can we highlight cost control levers (batching, quantization, caching) as bullet list under solution.

Kevin O'Neill: benchmark narrative for slide 6 (unique angle): lead with customer context (SaaS fintech, bursty peak hours), then the numbers, then the ops lesson: "pin model variant + autoscale buffer = predictable SLOs". keep the narrative <60 words.

Maya Patel: I'll compile a one-pager from these edits. Quick help on the webinar CTA flow: suggested flow -> demo + benchmark -> 2-min live Q&A -> CTA: "Request a runbook" (collect: infra size, compliance req, p99 target). Agree?

Sarah Gomez: agree. Add an alternate CTA for enterprise prospects: "Request an on-site/privileged pilot" (for heavy regulated buyers).

Tom Huang: small PR note — for promotional post, use headline: "How Redwood keeps LLM inference predictable for regulated platforms". keep social copy short.

Maya Patel: social copy draft (feel free to edit): "New webinar: make LLM inference predictable — real benchmark + ops playbook for regulated platforms. Wed 11am PT. Register: [link]"

Kevin O'Neill: suggestion: include a single benchmark tease in social: "See a 3x latency improvement in peak bursts" — gets clicks.

Maya Patel: good. OpsBot, please create calendar placeholder for speakers and add recording link placeholder.

OpsBot: Calendar event created: "Webinar — Predictable Inference for Regulated Platforms" on 2026-04-15 18:00 UTC. Speakers: Maya Patel, Kevin O'Neill. Recording placeholder: https://meet.redwood.example/recording/xxxx

Tom Huang: quick question — where do we host the one-pager? marketing assets or field enablement? prefer marketing with special tag so field can find it.

Maya Patel: host in marketing/doc-library and add "field-ready" tag. I'll attach the final one-pager to the event and to the post-webinar follow-up email.

Kevin O'Neill: doing a final pass on benchmark wording now, will dump 2 lines into the doc in ~30m.

Sarah Gomez: I'll add the canary flow slide and a small checklist slide for SEs.

Leo Rivera: adding HubSpot tags + inbound rule snippets to the routing doc now. will ping when live.

Maya Patel: great work team. plan: finalize assets by EOD for review tomorrow morning. if anyone has blockers DM me. :rocket:
